notes.text: Full second reading complete. Four material graphic/punctuation corrections and one certainty-only resolution are proposed. All seven original MARKS decisions remain unchanged. Fourteen of the fifteen accepted remaining doubts remain; only the tuple a/sim doubt is removed.

The input-tuple and central-parenthesis continuations each have two visible marks, represented by a point and short bar. The marginal F(j) continuation has three marks and the body z-prime continuation four; their counts are retained. The terminal marks in those latter groups are horizontally elongated, but no new mark is supplied or removed.

The named action datum a is a contextual reading of a graph admitting that hand formation, not correction of an unmistakable relation sign. The source comparison from scan017 was supplied by the main reader; Reader C inspected only scan018. The separate final lowercase pi is retained even though the surrounding mathematics may suggest Pi.

Both actual attachment guides were checked. The contr.-to-foncteur guide is already drawn; the pi-prefix guide was inventoried but absent from the accepted TeX and is added. The rising line through the old central parenthesis is a cancellation, not a further guide.

The existing separator was too long relative to the final marginal equivalence. Only its endpoint changes; the double left pointer, functor arrow, raised circle, subscript /F and all marginal wording remain.
